text: could we really not give them their actual names ? why is it all studiomdl
resolution: Package folders now carry the model's actual name: props/studio_mdl-mqy4h5yb-enm became props/weiner, build pieces read as door/, stage/, vault_door/, etc. The dir slug derives from the model name while the id stays the key inside manifest.json; the store resolves id->dir by scanning manifests with an in-memory index, name collisions get _2/_3 suffixes, and renaming a model now moves its folder to match. All 119 existing packages were git-mv'd to their names with internal viewerPaths rewritten; verified live that the running editor resolved every package with zero re-materialization under old slugs.
